title: 敢
teacherNotes: Accepted Production handoff. Latest origin/main is complete through L287, so L286 皮 and L287 痛 are already learned; build lesson-local complete package only and block until L288-L290 are in main. Use origin/main L001-L287 plus provisional learned chars [受,忍,耐] and current target 敢 for allowed-character audit. Do not confuse 敢 with 趕. Injury/pain scenes must remain gentle, child-safe, non-bloody, and non-medical-horror.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: origin/main L001-L287 + provisional learned chars [受,忍,耐] + current target 敢
usageNotes: This lesson uses 敢 as in 敢不敢, not 趕.
Images may depict small scraped skin, foot pain, and discomfort, but must not be bloody, severe, frightening, or medically intense.
Do not use unapproved display characters outside the allowed boundary.
Images must not contain text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, or watermarks.
imageRules: All sentence images must be square image / 1:1 composition.
Use L058 only as style reference, not person identity.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, brands, logos, or readable marks.
Pain and injury scenes must be gentle and safe: small discomfort only, no blood, no severe injury, no emergency, no horror.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 敢 as public/assets/lessons/L291/audio/char-u6562.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩手上有一點小傷口和破皮，她把臉稍微轉開，不敢看自己的傷口，主角媽媽在旁邊溫和安撫。畫面重點是傷口破皮、不敢看；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩和另一個孩子在安全遊戲中比力氣，例如雙手互推或一起搬一個很輕的玩具箱。畫面要像孩子在玩比力氣遊戲，不要危險動作；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 腳痛得受不了，我不敢跑。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 腳痛得受不了我不敢跑
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩坐在場邊或路邊，腳痛得受不了，所以不敢跑，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要清楚呈現腳痛、受不了、不敢跑；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩穿著太小的皮鞋坐在椅子上，腳已經痛了，但她不敢跟主角媽媽說，只好低頭忍耐。主角媽媽在旁邊或前方整理東西，還沒有發現她不舒服。畫面重點是不敢說、只好忍耐；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 不要忍耐，難受要和大人說。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 不要忍耐難受要和大人說
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 延續上一句情境，主角媽媽發現主角小女孩很難受，蹲下來關心她，主角小女孩坐在椅子上指著太小的皮鞋或腳。畫面要清楚呈現媽媽提醒她不要一直忍耐，難受要和大人說；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

stage4Plan.reason: 「敢不敢」是本課核心問句用法，目標字出現清楚。
